subject: NexusPay collection lag & provisional VAT journal request
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: NexusPay - 11/2026 unapplied receipts & VAT provisional?

Rishi,

We're seeing a collection lag for NexusPay for November invoices that is starting to push AR past our 60-day aging threshold. Summary below (all USD):

- INV-20261104: $28,450 (due 11/30)
- INV-20261117: $12,000 (due 11/30)
- INV-20261129: $6,720 (due 12/15 but payment sent 11/30)

Collections team has a partial remittance in banking, but the remittance statement doesn't match invoice references. Also, NexusPay's statement shows VAT deducted on a consolidated remit line (VAT 5% withheld) which we didn't anticipate for this reseller.

Can you: 
1) Reach out to NexusPay collections to request a remittance CSV and clarification on their VAT withholding?
2) If they confirm withholding, request a provisional VAT withholding journal amount so accounting can accrue against revenue/AR end-of-month.

Attaching the banking trace we have and the statement stub we pulled.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior AR Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nexus_Statement_Nov2026.pdf (PDF), bank_trace_20261130.txt (text)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@nexuspay.com>, collections@nexuspay.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: NexusPay - 11/2026 unapplied receipts & VAT provisional?

Hi Priya / NexusPay collections team — looping you in from our side.

Grace pulled a few invoices where we have funds in bank but can't match to invoices because the remittance doesn't include invoice numbers. Can you please: 
- Send a CSV of the 30-Nov remittance showing invoice IDs, amounts, and any VAT/withholding lines (we need a per-invoice breakdown).
- Confirm whether NexusPay withheld VAT on reseller payments for November, and if so, the policy/authority for that withholding and whether you can provide a provisional withholding amount we can reflect as an accrual.

We're trying to avoid writing off or misclassing revenue at month-end. If it's easier, please send whatever statement or file you have and we can map on our side.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround, ideally by EOD Thursday PST.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@nexuspay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@nexuspay.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RE: NexusPay - 11/2026 unapplied receipts & VAT provisional?

Rishi — thanks for flagging. Apologies for the confusion; our AP team processed a consolidated remit on 2026-11-30 and we do have a withholding line applied for VAT (local policy for our region). I've attached the statement and a remittance export: NexusRemit_202611.csv (columns: remit_id, invoice_ref, gross_amt, vat_withheld, net_paid).

Quick notes:
- Our csv shows INV-20261104 matched to remit_id RP-981 (gross 28,450, vat_withheld 1,422.50, net_paid 27,027.50)
- INV-20261117 was included but without invoice_ref in our export due to a formatting issue; we're re-exporting that row and will follow up by EOD.
- INV-20261129 shows as fully paid (net) in our system.

We don't have a formal certificate at the moment but can provide a withholding advice and the AP contact for any tax authority questions. Hope this helps for an initial accrual.

Regards,
Priya Sharma
Head of AP Operations
NexusPay

Attachments: NexusRemit_202611.csv, Nexus_Statement_Nov2026.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed provisional VAT accrual and journal (draft)

I've reviewed Priya's remit export. Based on the remit row for RP-981 and the missing row for INV-20261117 (pending re-export), proposed provisional entries to close month: 

- Debit: Accounts Receivable — NexusPay (INV-20261104) $1,422.50 (VAT withholding accrual)
- Credit: VAT Withholding Payable $1,422.50

If INV-20261117's re-export confirms an additional withholding we will post a catch-up journal early next week. For now I'm attaching a draft journal file with line-level mapping to our revmap: provisional-vat-journal-draft.xlsx

Lauren — can you confirm the revenue recognition mapping to ensure the withheld amount doesn't trigger a revenue reversal? My read is this is a cash-withholding issue and revenue should stand, but want product/revops sign-off.

Marcus Lin
Accounting Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional-vat-journal-draft.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed provisional VAT accrual and journal (draft)

Thanks Marcus — looks reasonable to me.

Lauren — appreciate a quick confirm (1-liner) that we don't need to reverse revenue on INV-20261104 if we accrue VAT withholding as Marcus proposed. Once confirmed we'll: 
- Post the provisional VAT withholding journal at month-end (finance to post)
- Hold AR as 'partially applied' and allocate net received amount against invoices in our posting batch once NexusPay's corrected CSV arrives
- If NexusPay provides a withholding certificate later, we'll clear the payable upon receipt — otherwise follow up for refund/credit API.

Grace — please keep NexusPay engaged to get the corrected CSV for INV-20261117 and confirm when they have AP contact for the tax authority.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
